spec.title: Overhead Time
spec.description: Time per heartbeat not accounted for by Idle, Datagram, or Send — includes Python loop overhead, metric publishing, message deserialization, and tracing.

spec.title: Datagram Time
spec.description: Total graph execution time across all events in the heartbeat interval.

spec.title: Pruned Heartbeats/Sec
spec.description: Rate of heartbeats processed with incomplete worker contributions due to timeout.

spec.title: Datagram Bytes/Heartbeat
spec.description: Result payload size sent from workers to collectors per heartbeat.

spec.title: Graph Version
spec.description: Currently loaded computation graph version. Increments on each graph modification.

spec.title: Datagrams/Sec
spec.description: Events processed per second per worker. "Total Rate" is the sum across all workers.

spec.title: Transitions
spec.description: Cumulative system state transitions (Configure, Enable, Disable, etc.).

spec.title: Plot Latency
spec.description: End-to-end latency from heartbeat creation at the data source to display in the GUI client.

spec.title: Plot RSS
spec.description: Memory used by the AMI GUI process for display nodes.

spec.title: Exemplars
spec.description: P99 heartbeat duration with exemplar markers linking sampled heartbeats to distributed Tempo traces. Each dot represents one traced heartbeat.

spec.title: Send Time
spec.description: Time spent serializing and transmitting results downstream per heartbeat.

spec.title: Heartbeat Budget $process
spec.description: Heartbeat interval breakdown by phase — Idle, Datagram (graph execution), Send, and Overhead — as percentages summing to 100%.

spec.expr:
rate(ami_event_count_total{hutch="$hutch", type="Datagram"}[30s])
     / on(hutch, process, instance, job)
     rate(ami_event_count_total{hutch="$hutch", type="Heartbeat"}[30s])

(
  avg by (hutch, graph_name, id, title, subtitle) (
    rate(ami_graph_node_exec_seconds_total{hutch="$hutch", graph_name=~"$graph_name", color="worker"}[30s])
    / on(hutch, instance) group_left()
    rate(ami_event_count_total{hutch="$hutch", type="Heartbeat"}[30s])
  )
  + on(hutch, graph_name, id, title, subtitle) group_left()
  (
    sum by (hutch, graph_name, id, title, subtitle) (
      rate(ami_graph_node_exec_seconds_total{hutch="$hutch", graph_name=~"$graph_name", color=~"localCollector|globalCollector"}[30s])
      / on(hutch, instance) group_left()
      rate(ami_event_count_total{hutch="$hutch", type="Heartbeat"}[30s])
    )
    or
    (0 * avg by (hutch, graph_name, id, title, subtitle) (
      rate(ami_graph_node_exec_seconds_total{hutch="$hutch", graph_name=~"$graph_name", color="worker"}[30s])
      / on(hutch, instance) group_left()
      rate(ami_event_count_total{hutch="$hutch", type="Heartbeat"}[30s])
    ))
  )
)
or
(
  0 * sum by (hutch, graph_name, id, title, subtitle) (ami_graph_node{hutch="$hutch", graph_name=~"$graph_name"})
  unless on(hutch, graph_name, id)
  avg by (hutch, graph_name, id, title, subtitle) (
    rate(ami_graph_node_exec_seconds_total{hutch="$hutch", graph_name=~"$graph_name", color="worker"}[30s])
  )
)

spec.title: Graph Node Execution Time
spec.description: Average graph node worker execution time plus collector time per heartbeat.

      / on(hutch, instance) group_left()

      / on(hutch, instance) group_left()

or

spec.title: Idle Time
spec.description: Time workers spent waiting for the next event, or collectors waiting for upstream contributions.

spec.title: Heartbeats/Sec
spec.description: Heartbeat boundary rate per process. Should match the configured heartbeat frequency (default 1 Hz).

spec.title: Partial Events/Sec
spec.description: Events processed with incomplete detector contributions.
